values.note: No reservations; hook-up sites go first come, first served to arrivals before 4:30 pm (the welcome center closes at 5 pm).

booking.source: https://www.destinationbedfordva.com/contact-us/welcome-center/ ('RV dump station and hook-ups are available if the sites are not full and arrival time is before 4:30pm. No reservations accepted.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Closed Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

season.source: Visit Virginia's Blue Ridge (regional tourism office) listing https://www.visitroanokeva.com/listings/bedford-area-welcome-center-and-destination-bedford/5968/ ('The sites are open year round except for Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and New Year's Day'), read 2026-10-20; the welcome center's own page says only that it is open 'January thru December ... summary: Confirmed no reservations / first come (before 4:30 pm) and the dump station on the welcome center's own page. Season year-round (closed three holidays) from the regional tourism listing, marked reported. The regional listing also gives 3 one-night full-hookup sites (water, electric, sewer, wifi) at $25/night and $10 parking without hookups, but undated, so fees not written; amperage (50) is stated nowhere and was left as derived.
